description: This file declares classes and interfaces related to container management using the runc implementation within the Thunder project. It defines the RunCContainer class for individual container operations and RunCContainerAdministrator for managing container instances.

classes.name: RunCContainer
classes.description: Represents a container managed via runc, providing methods to control and query container state.

classes.name: RunCContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Factory class for creating and managing multiple RunCContainer instances.

methods.name: RunCContainer(const string& id, const string& path, const string& logPath)
methods.description: Constructor initializing a container with specified ID, path, and log path.

methods.name: Type()
methods.description: Returns the container type, specifically RUNC.

methods.name: Pid()
methods.description: Returns the process ID of the container.

methods.name: IsRunning()
methods.description: Checks if the container is currently running.

methods.name: Start(const string& command, IStringIterator& parameters)
methods.description: Starts the container with specified command and parameters.

methods.name: Stop(const uint32_t timeout)
methods.description: Stops the container, with a timeout.

methods.name: Memory()
methods.description: Returns memory info of the container.

methods.name: ProcessorInfo()
methods.description: Returns processor info of the container.

methods.name: NetworkInterfaces()
methods.description: Returns network interfaces of the container.

methods.name: InternalPurge(const uint32_t timeout)
methods.description: Performs internal cleanup of the container.

methods.name: Container(const string& id, IStringIterator& searchpaths, const string& logpath, const string& configuration)
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a container instance.

methods.name: Initialize(const string& configuration)
methods.description: Initializes the container administrator with configuration.
